articles.summary: Hi, there! 👋 Something I keep noticing: Ecommerce product teams are moving faster than almost anyone right now — and somehow still feel like they can't keep up. 🫠 Well, I have news for you. You're not alone! There is more experiments, more personalization, and more AI surface area to cover. But the market keeps moving faster than the roadmap. 📈 I put together a panel for June 25 specifically because of this. 💁‍♀️ Giovanni Bryden, our Director and Global Head of Solutions Engineering, is sitting down with Gandharv Kalra (Mejuri) and Artin Bogdanov (SUN) — two people actually building through this, with pretty different approaches and honestly some different opinions on where it's all going. If you're on an ecommerce product team, this one's for you. 📅 June 25 — 9 AM PT / 12 PM ET Save your seat (https://events.mixpanel.com/ecommerce-productstrategy/?utm_source=event&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=AmericasEcommQ2FY27%20-%20Webinar1&utm_content=webinar)
articles.title: Ecommerce Product Teams Panel: Navigating Faster Market Changes and AI on June 25
